# AMI Meeting Corpus recording

The AMI Consortium recorded meeting ES2002a. This fixture contains seconds 30 through 150 of the mixed headset recording, cropped to 120 seconds with the original 16 kHz mono PCM samples. [Original recording](https://groups.inf.ed.ac.uk/ami/AMICorpusMirror/amicorpus/ES2002a/audio/ES2002a.Mix-Headset.wav) · [AMI Meeting Corpus](https://groups.inf.ed.ac.uk/ami/download/) · [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
